decisions.reason: The hearty loaf sits close to the core bread range and costs little to keep, so the craft bakery has little reason to abandon a product it already invested in.
The sweet pastry fits the established confectionery offer, and with no evidence of failure, management is inclined to persist with this earlier launch.
The farmhouse bread is a natural extension of the traditional bread assortment, and dropping it would mean conceding an earlier decision without clear cause.

The award-winning poppy seed stollen is publicly presented as a flagship with its own page, so it is highly visible and central to the firm's announced direction, and the firm is strongly committed to it.
The premium stollen carries a gold award that the firm advertises publicly and anchors its seasonal gift business, so keeping it is easy to justify.
